description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the CLI at scripts/evoagentx_cli.py. 2. Agent runs `python3 scripts/evoagentx_cli.py create-workflow --name DataQualityWorkflow --description '<genomics description>'` which generates data_quality_workflow.py with a CLI stamp and boilerplate. 3. Agent edits data_quality_workflow.py to: (a) keep the `from evoagentx import Agent, Workflow` import; (b) ensure `class DataQualityWorkflow(Workflow)` inheritance; (c) implement `async def execute(self, context)` body; (d) add `from evoagentx.evolution import EvolutionEngine` and call `engine.evolve(...)` with `evaluation_criteria={'accuracy': <float>}`; (e) name one of the three proprietary strategies (TextGrad, AFlow, or MIPRO); (f) define a genome dict containing all four GEP fields: task_type_classification, approach_methodology, outcome_metrics, context_requirements. The key proprietary trap is the four-field GEP genome structure and the requirement to use the CLI to scaffold the file (evidenced by the CLI stamp), rather than writing from scratch.
